reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 9.4 gives Customer an unqualified without-cause termination right over the Agreement or any Order Form, caps Customer's exposure at accrued Fees, and requires Vendor to refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (pro-rata refund, echoed in Section 10.2).
The notice period resolves correctly via the cross-reference: Section 29.4 fixes thirty days before the effective termination date, matching the preferred 30-day position exactly.

Directionally correct on the Vendor side: the only Vendor termination rights in the cited paragraphs are mutual for-cause (material breach, Section 9.1) and insolvency (Section 9.2); no Vendor convenience/without-cause exit is present during the committed term.
No early-termination fee, penalty, or acceleration is attached to the Customer right in the cited text, consistent with the preferred position.

Appropriately no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the deterministic check ('Customer convenience termination present') corroborates the assessment, and the rendered redline is identical to the originals as expected.
